import sqlite3


def connect(path):
    db = sqlite3.connect(path)
    db.execute("create table if not exists items(id integer primary key, stock integer, reserved integer)")
    db.execute("create table if not exists hires(item_id integer)")
    return db


# flowguard: sensor AVAILABLE
def can_hire(db: sqlite3.Connection, item_id: int, stock: int, reserved: int) -> bool:
    row = db.execute("select stock, reserved from items where id=?", (item_id,)).fetchone()
    return stock > reserved and row is not None


# flowguard: sensor HIRES
def hire_count(db: sqlite3.Connection, item_id: int, stock: int, reserved: int) -> int:
    db.execute("insert into hires(item_id) values (?)", (item_id,))
    (count,) = db.execute("select count(*) from hires").fetchone()
    return count + stock - reserved
